description:
Get one person’s full public profile: bio, languages, hours, rate, rating and paid track record.
Use for: deciding whether to hire someone you found.
Not for: finding people (list_humans); reading what others wrote about them (list_reviews).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_human({"humanId":"h2Lw9QxT4mZp7Rk"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

humanId.description: The id from list_humans. Their username also works.

name: get_human

availability.description: Hours they say they can work each day, HH:mm in `timezone`.

avatarUrl.description: May be left out while their profile is incomplete.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

hourlyRate.description: What they ask per hour. Left out when their rate is in another currency.

name.description: May be first name and last initial while their profile is incomplete. Left out when they gave none.

paidJobCount.description: Jobs they were paid for through the platform. Left out when it could not be counted.

average.description: Average review score. Left out when there are no reviews yet, not for a low one.

repeatPosterCount.description: Posters who paid them for two or more jobs. Left out when it could not be counted.

verifiedLanguages.description: Languages proven by a speaking check.

withdrawalCount.description: Jobs they left after starting. Left out when it could not be counted.

title: Get a human
